workspace.README.md:
# Configuration merge contract
merge_config(base, overrides) merges two dictionaries and returns a new one.
Missing override keys keep base values. An explicit None overrides a base
value with None. Dictionaries merge recursively when both values are dicts;
all other values, including lists, are replaced. Neither input may be changed,
and mutating nested lists/dicts in the result must not change either input.
Empty nested overrides preserve existing keys. Fixed tests/config are immutable.
